# distributed-lock

> Lease-based locks with monotonic fencing tokens in Go: a Store interface, an in-memory store with an injected clock, a blocking Locker and a fence checker Go module `github.com/Trysac/u142-distributed-lock`, package `distributedlock`, MIT licensed,
> Go >= 1.23, standard library only.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
